parameters.content: **Stale request follow-up.** Every day at 10:00 (instance timezone) ask Convex for requests that are still undecided. Requests older than 48 hours get one email to the owner (a nudge, written back right after the send). Requests whose start date has passed are expired through Convex, which notifies the borrower itself; this workflow never emails for expiry, and a skipped answer means the owner decided first, which counts as success. Convex returns at most 200 items per call, so when more remain the workflow fetches again (up to 10 pages). If anything failed, the run ends with one summarized error so the error workflow fires. Use Run manually to test.
